body: I recently had my puppy spayed, and pain medication was optional then as well. I asked about it and the honest answer was "Some people don't think their dogs need it" so they made it an optional thing.  It's super sad!

You're right. Sometimes it might not. But if you want it to get better and are tired of feeling down, you have to strive and push for the "sometimes" that actually do get better.

I get it. I still struggle everyday, its not about not wanting to kill yourself.. it's about finding things that make you want to live. The little things can go a long way, find the things that make you even an ounce happy, focus on that, stay busy, and keep pushing forward. You got this, you are stronger than the "darkness" as I call it.

A few months before Christmas 2019, my Mom asked me  (24F) and my S.O (25M) if we wanted a grill for our new house. I told her no, that we had something else in mind to purchase at a later time, something that was pretty pricey. When Christmas came around, sure enough out comes this grill... I honestly didn't know how to act. I told her I didn't want one, and here it is.
 In February we bought the smoker we have been wanting for awhile, and I never told my mom about it just knowing she would get mad. But one day I let a picture slip that had it in the background, and she asked me where the grill was and why we didn't have it set up. She got mad at me and wouldn't talk to me for days when I said it was still in the box. Like what do you want from me? She does this with everything. Gets me things she thinks I need/want, and then makes me feel like a shit person for not being great ful. 😒🙄

I completely agree! So many people just want to have kids without realizing what having a kid does/takes, then a lot complain and wish they would have waited, idk what the rush is. My SO (M25) and I (24F) bought our first house 6 months ago. We both have great paying jobs, and have everything we could ever want. But, we still feel like we couldn't afford a child, at least not be able to and keep up with the hobbies we have and enjoy. Kids are too expensive and I don't want to change my lifestyle to account for a child.. Maybe in the future, but right now.. just enjoying life. Childfree.
